# Transforming Code Reviews with AI

## Features

**Automated Reviews**: Continuous reviews of the pull requests including incremental commits. 

**Summarization**: Generates high-level summary and a technical walkthrough of the PR changes. 

**Line-by-line review**: Provides line-by-line suggestions committable with one click.

**Codebase verification**:  Verifies the impact on the overall codebase and identifies missing changes.

**Insights into your code**:  Ask any questions on your codebase within the pull request 

**Chat about your code** : Chat with the bot around your code. The more you chat, the smarter it gets.

**Issue Validation**:  Validates the PR against the linked issues and identifies other related issues

Code Review by Qodo

🐞 Bugs (1) 📘 Rule violations (0) 📜 Skill insights (0)
1. Redirect restores source context 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness
>
>Description >
> >
>During follow_redirects=True, Werkzeug recursively calls FlaskClient.open, so the pending list
>contains the source context followed by the destination context. Replaying with pop() enters the
>destination first and source last, leaving request bound to the redirect source instead of the
>final response.
>
>
>
>Code >
> >[src/flask/testing.py[244]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/pull/6220/files#diff-8b6ebc456dd7ce1ab0df544ee20d38211b947ad84e600b2727e4dd5db9fe913eR244-R244) > >```diff >+ self._context_stack.enter_context(self._new_contexts.pop()) >``` >
>
>Evidence >
> >
>Flask installs _new_contexts.append as the preservation callback, and wsgi_app invokes it for
>every request before popping that request's context. Werkzeug's redirect implementation calls
>self.open(...), dynamically re-entering FlaskClient.open before the outer call reaches its
>replay block; consequently, a one-hop redirect accumulates [source, destination]. The changed
>pop() loop enters destination and then source, while AppContext.push makes each newly entered
>context active, so the source is exposed after the final response; the prior FIFO loop left
>destination active.
>
> > [src/flask/testing.py[185-189]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/ce371565d0889138abb2c2c60e02e59714dbf2c9/src/flask/testing.py/#L185-L189) > [src/flask/app.py[1595-1619]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/ce371565d0889138abb2c2c60e02e59714dbf2c9/src/flask/app.py/#L1595-L1619) > [src/flask/ctx.py[416-434]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/ce371565d0889138abb2c2c60e02e59714dbf2c9/src/flask/ctx.py/#L416-L434) > [src/flask/testing.py[230-245]](https://github.com/seonho12-54/qodo-coderabbit-benchmark/blob/ce371565d0889138abb2c2c60e02e59714dbf2c9/src/flask/testing.py/#L230-L245) > 🌐 [Werkzeug's current `Client.resolve_redirect` implementation follows the redirect by returning `self.open(builder, buffered=buffered)`.](https://github.com/pallets/werkzeug/blob/main/src/werkzeug/test.py) >
>
>Agent prompt >
> >``` >The issue below was found during a code review. Follow the provided context and guidance below and implement a solution > >## Issue description >Preserved contexts are appended in request order, but replaying them with `list.pop()` reverses that order. For a followed redirect, the source context becomes active instead of the final destination context. > >## Issue Context >Werkzeug follows redirects by recursively dispatching through `self.open`. Preserve FIFO entry order, and add a regression test asserting that `request.path` refers to the final redirect destination inside a preserving client block. > >## Fix Focus Areas >- src/flask/testing.py[230-245] >- tests/test_testing.py[367-381] >``` > ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools >

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
